chapter_name: Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings: Cultural Developments
learning_objective: 🛕 Dive into the rich tapestry of ancient Indian philosophies, the rise of Buddhism and Jainism, and the magnificent architecture of Stupas!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Before new religions emerged, the Vedic tradition dominated, involving elaborate sacrifices (like Rajasuya and Ashvamedha) performed by chiefs and kings to ensure victory, health, and sons.

Jainism teaches that the entire world is animated (even rocks have life). The core principle is extreme Ahimsa (non-violence). The cycle of birth and rebirth is shaped by karma, which must be destroyed through penance and asceticism.

Buddhism focuses on the Middle Path, avoiding extreme luxury or severe penance. The world is transient (anicca) and soulless (anatta). Sorrow is intrinsic to human existence, and one can escape this cycle by ending desire to attain Nirvana.

Stupas were built over relics of the Buddha. The Sanchi Stupa survived because it was protected by the Begums of Bhopal. Stupas consist of an Anda (dome), Harmika (balcony), and Yashti (mast), surrounded by a stone railing.

Over time, Buddhism split into Mahayana (which worshiped Buddha as a savior with statues) and Hinayana/Theravada (older tradition). Simultaneously, Puranic Hinduism grew with the worship of Shiva and Vishnu in early structural temples.

fun_activity.title: 🏛️ Virtual Tour of Sanchi
fun_activity.instructions: Look up images of the gateways (Toranas) at Sanchi. Notice that early Buddhist art didn't show Buddha in human form! Instead, his presence was indicated by symbols like an empty seat, a wheel (dhamma), or a tree.

exam_tips: 📌 The role of the Begums of Bhopal (Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum) is a highly repeated question regarding the preservation of Sanchi Stupa.
📌 Distinguish clearly between Mahayana Buddhism (idol worship, saviors, Bodhisattvas) and Hinayana (self-effort, Buddha as a human teacher).
📌 Remember the 5 vows of Jain monks: not to kill, steal, lie, own property, and to observe celibacy.
quick_recap: ⭐ The Rigveda consists of hymns praising deities like Agni, Indra, and Soma.
⭐ Tripitaka (Three Baskets) are the core Buddhist texts: Sutta, Vinaya, and Abhidhamma Pitaka.
⭐ Amaravati Stupa was destroyed because its marbles were taken away by British officers, unlike Sanchi which remained intact.
